request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited Bitcoin-Cardano bridge running on Cardano mainnet in federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access
SPO/dApp partner pipeline required for public launch
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 funding to take Bifrost from working testnet to launch readiness, including hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, and stewardship and economic foundations for launch.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's existing SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The bridge is on testnet today under Catalyst Fund 14 and is intended to prove the architecture end-to-end on Bitcoin Testnet4 and Cardano Preprod by August 2026.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, described as approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA and including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO-threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Public rollout and 24 months of operations are intentionally excluded from this proposal and deferred to a Phase 2 proposal in Q1 2027.
The proposers claim Bitcoin represents roughly $1.6 trillion in value and that only around 1% of BTC supply is currently used in DeFi.
Bifrost custody is described as distributed across 400+ Cardano SPOs, weighted by delegation, with fund movement requiring a threshold representing the majority of delegated stake.
The proposers state Bifrost has no bridge token, no founder allocation, Apache 2.0 open-source components, public reporting, and an independent stewardship structure to be determined in Phase 1.
Bifrost targets 1,200 BTC TVL by Q2 2029, about 600,000 annual transactions, 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets, and fee-funded operations with surplus to SPOs and the Cardano Treasury.
The document states Bifrost has a Catalyst Fund 14 grant of ₳739,000, 585 approving votes, and approved completed milestones for architecture and minimal testable smart-contract and Watchtower paths.

summary: The proposal seeks ₳12.332031 million for FluidTokens and Lantr Engineering to complete Phase 1 launch-readiness work for Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, with major claims around SPO-secured custody, testnet progress, audits, formal verification, open-source public infrastructure, and future BTC liquidity adoption.
